format: A slab holds comparison bundles. Each bundle names one pivot passage and partner passages from other branches (ids into 'passages'). Cite passages by their 'id' and claims by bundle. Passages marked research_only come from sources whose licence forbids commercial use or has not been checked. Every passage carries 'licence' and 'licence_tag': consent-train (CELT, used with consent for research and training; never redistributed), research (research only), nc (non-commercial), nd (no derivatives), pd (public domain), cc-by, cc-by-sa, gpl, unchecked. Lemmas marked '(name)' are proper names and are not mapped.
